before_text: I ran CI and benchmarked the new parser against main (18 runs each). The last 12 CI runs on main went pass, pass, pass, pass, fail, pass, pass, pass, pass, pass, fail, fail (9 of 12 passed, 3 failed). small.json went from 1.92 ms to 1.41 ms (−27%, 95% CI −30% to −24%), medium.json from 18.4 ms to 12.9 ms (−30%, −33% to −27%), large.json from 212 ms to 151 ms (−29%, −31% to −27%), nested.json from 44.0 ms to 46.1 ms (+5%, +2% to +8%, a regression), and unicode.json from 31.2 ms to 22.8 ms (−27%, −30% to −24%). On large.json median latency was 151 ms (IQR 149 to 153 ms) with one 240 ms outlier. Peak memory fell from 84 MB to 61 MB.
